description_preview:
Company Description
Meridian brings context-aware AI agents to industries that have traditionally been overlooked in technology adoption such as supply chain, manufacturing, staffing and more. The company works closely with sector experts to automate operations, enhance decision-making, and unlock new efficiencies through applied AI. Meridian is backed by leading investors, including Sunflower Capital, Pear VC, SV Angel, and angels from Anthropic. Team members join a fast-moving environment where they can shape products from the ground up and see their work deployed directly in critical industry workflows.
Role Description
As a Software Engineer Intern at Meridian, you will work full time on-site in New York, NY, collaborating closely with engineers and product team members to build and improve AI-driven software. Comfort with learning new tools and frameworks, and openness to feedback and code review.
Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and clear written and verbal communication.

title: AI Full Stack Engineer
description_preview:
About Ruby Advisory
Ruby Advisory builds human-first AI systems for ambitious teams.
We help companies find where time, energy, and efficiency are leaking inside their daily work, then build practical AI systems that give that value back. Our work lives inside the workflows teams already rely on: lead follow-up, company knowledge, admin and operations, proposal drafting, client delivery, internal tools, and repeatable processes that are too important to stay manual.
Ruby’s approach blends build, implementation, and education. We design systems around how a team actually works, help those systems become part of the business, and teach people how to use AI with confidence in their real work.
About The Role
We are hiring an AI Systems Developer who can build, operate, and improve AI-powered systems for Ruby and our clients.
This role combines software development, systems engineering, AI automation, workflow design, and technical operations. You will work from real client context: calls, transcripts, documents, workflows, data, existing tools, business goals, and messy operational details. From there, you will help decide what should be built, how it should work, and how to ship it.
You should be a strong coder and a daily AI power user. We want someone who is actively using modern AI tools, testing new models, improving their development workflow, and staying close to where the AI tooling ecosystem is moving.
What You Will Work On
AI-powered client workflows
Full agent builds for companies
Custom AI software products and SaaS-style tools
Internal tools and operating systems
Automations for repeated business processes
Agentic workflows and multi-step AI pipelines
Proposal, research, drafting, and QA workflows
Lightweight dashboards and review tools
Integrations across the tools clients already use
Systems that help teams adopt AI confidently
Responsibilities
Build AI systems, full agents, automations, internal tools, custom software products, and client delivery workflows.
Turn client calls, transcripts, notes, documents, and business context into structured plans and working systems.
Use AI coding tools, LLMs, model APIs, workflow tools, and automation platforms to move quickly.
Make practical technical decisions when requirements are incomplete.
Understand how a client team works and design systems that fit their actual process.
Design agentic workflows that can reason through multi-step tasks, use tools, handle context, and produce reliable outputs.
Build complex software solutions that combine frontend, backend, AI logic, integrations, data flows, and human review.
Prototype quickly, test with real use, and improve based on feedback.
Identify missing context, ask sharp questions, and keep work moving.
Create reusable components, prompts, workflows, and documentation.
Help Ruby improve its own delivery systems, internal operations, and client implementation process.
Stay current with AI tools, models, agent frameworks, coding agents, automation tools, and practical AI use cases.
Communicate clearly about progress, blockers, tradeoffs, and next steps.
What We Are Looking For
We are looking for someone who is technically strong, highly autonomous, curious, adaptive, and genuinely AI-native.
You should be comfortable taking messy inputs and turning them into useful outputs. A client call becomes a workflow map. A transcript becomes a project plan. A repeated manual task becomes an automation. A scattered knowledge base becomes a system people can actually use.
The right person can move between coding, product thinking, systems design, client context, and deliverable quality. You can go deep on your own, come back with real progress, and explain your decisions clearly.
Required Skills
Strong coding ability in a modern stack such as TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, or similar.
Understanding of agentic workflows and agent builds.
Daily use of AI tools for software development, research, automation, or systems work.
Experience building with LLMs, AI APIs, agent workflows, automations, or AI-assisted development workflows.
Ability to build full software solutions, not only prompts or simple automations.
Ability to turn ambiguous business context into clear technical execution.
Strong systems thinking across people, tools, data, prompts, workflows, and outputs.
High autonomy, strong follow-through, and good judgment.
Clear written communication.
Comfort working with transcripts, documents, spreadsheets, client notes, and operational data.
Curiosity, adaptability, and a willingness to challenge assumptions constructively.
Nice To Have
Experience with TypeScript, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, Supabase, Vercel, Airtable, Notion, Zapier, Make, n8n, or similar tools.
Experience with AI coding tools such as Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar.
Experience with prompt design, structured outputs, evals, retrieval, tool calling, or multi-step AI workflows.
Experience building internal tools, dashboards, agent workflows, or operational systems.
Experience working directly with clients, founders, operators, or non-technical stakeholders.
Experience in consulting, agencies, startups, automation, RevOps, or high-autonomy technical roles.
The Type Of Person Who Will Thrive
You will probably do well here if you:
Like turning unclear problems into working systems.
Test new AI tools because you are genuinely curious.
Can work independently and return with thoughtful execution.
Ask better questions without slowing the work down.
Care about whether people actually use what you build.
Enjoy practical systems more than theory.
Want to help define how modern AI implementation work gets done.

Foundation models that read an entire CT study, not one slice at a time

One model that catches many urgent findings at once, calibrated to operate safely in front of a radiologist

At R3, we are building the on-ramp for the next trillion dollars of assets to move on-chain, bridging the worlds of traditional finance (TradFi) and decentralized finance (DeFi). We are launching institutional-grade RWA yield vaults, fully composable and integrated into Solana DeFi.
Our Corda Protocol is an institutional tokenized Real World Asset platform built on Solana. KYC'd investors deposit stablecoins into RWA vaults in exchange for vault tokens, and redeem the oracle-priced vault tokens back into stablecoins, with curators buying and selling the corresponding assets out in the Real World to settle those on-chain token transactions.
The Role
We're looking for a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build and ship production RWA trading and lending infrastructure on Solana. You'll work across the stack, from on-chain programs to the front ends investors, traders and integrators use. You'll be working on systems that move real capital: liquidity venues, lending markets, and market-making infrastructure. This is a hands-on role for someone who has a genuine interest in bringing regulated finance on-chain and has already shipped DeFi protocols on Solana and understands the operational realities of running them under load.
As an early team member, you will play a crucial role in shaping the Corda Protocol. You should care as much about security, compliance, and auditability as you do about shipping quickly.
Responsibilities
• Influence the design and development of the Corda Protocol RWA yield marketplace to scale it to multichain & multi-curator future
• Design and build Solana programs (Rust/Anchor) for vaults, order books, AMMs, lending markets, or related liquidity infrastructure.
• Build the full stack around these programs: indexers, keepers/crankers, APIs, and the React/TypeScript front ends that expose them to users and integrators.
• Work directly on market-making and liquidity systems and the plumbing that keeps venues liquid and solvent.
• Participate in code review, threat modelling, and internal/external audits of new and existing programs.
• Design, implement, and optimize SDKs that will power our integration with centralized partners (exchanges, wallets, neobanks).
Required Skills/Experience
• Prior experience at a crypto-native or web3 engineering team is a must; you will have worked at a lending protocol, yield marketplace, vaults infra or any similar marketplace that connected onchain allocators to the curated vaults.
• Minimum of 6 years in software development and 3 years of experience in Rust with meaningful production time on Solana.
• Proven experience shipping and deploying Solana programs in Rust (Anchor or native), ideally in one or more of: order book or AMM-style liquidity venues, lending/borrowing protocols, or market-making systems.
• Full stack range: comfortable owning on-chain program logic and the off-chain services and front end (TypeScript/React, Node) that surround it.
• Solid understanding of Solana's account model, PDAs, CPI, transaction/compute limits, and the tradeoffs involved in high-throughput on-chain systems.
Nice to Haves
• Experience owning architecture & delivery.
• MPC wallets/custody, Squads, on-chain monitoring, AML screening.
• Familiarity with Kubernetes concepts & Kubernetes networking, Terraform, PostgreSQL.
• PKI and other cryptographic knowledge.
• Experience supporting systems in production and investigating & diagnosing issues for internal or external customers.
• Experience of Linux, shell scripting or other scripting languages, Linux command line tools, TCP/IP networking.
• Java / Kotlin.

Technical Management skills
